shloka_text: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः । अवाक्छिरास्तथाभूत्वा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। 7.76.1 ।।
transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā rāmasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ | avākchirāstathābhūtvā vākyametaduvāca ha || 7.76.1 ||
translation: तस्य his, तद्वचनं that speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः of Rama, whose deeds are unblemished, अवाक्छिरास्तथाभूत्वा having become thus with head bowed down, वाक्यमेतदुवाच spoke this statement, ह indeed.
explanation: Having heard those words of Rama, whose deeds are unblemished, the ascetic, with his head still bowed, then spoke the following words.
comments: The ascetic declares himself Shambuka, a Shudra seeking heaven in his own body by penance, and Rama draws his sword and beheads him, the gods raining flowers -- offered a boon, Rama asks that the brahmin's son be revived, and learns the boy lived again the moment Shambuka fell -- Rama then visits Agastya, who gives him a divine ornament and, when Rama hesitates to accept a brahmin's gift, explains its lawfulness and begins its tale.

shloka_text: शूद्रयोन्यां प्रसूतो ऽस्मि शम्बूको नाम नामतः । देवत्वं पार्थये राम सशरीरो महायशः ।। 7.76.2 ।।
transliteration: śūdrayonyāṃ prasūto 'smi śambūko nāma nāmataḥ | devatvaṃ pārthaye rāma saśarīro mahāyaśaḥ || 7.76.2 ||
translation: शूद्रयोन्यां in a Shudra womb, प्रसूतो born, ऽस्मि I am, शम्बूको Shambuka, नाम named, नामतः by name, देवत्वं divinity, पार्थये I seek, राम O Rama, सशरीरो with my body, महायशः O greatly renowned one.
explanation: The ascetic declared that he was born in a Shudra family, named Shambuka, and that he sought to attain divinity with his physical body, O greatly renowned Rama.

shloka_text: न मिथ्या ऽहं वदे राम देवलोकजिगीषया । शूद्रं मां विद्धि काकुत्स्थ तप उग्रं समास्थितम् ।। 7.76.3 ।।
transliteration: na mithyā 'haṃ vade rāma devalokajigīṣayā | śūdraṃ māṃ viddhi kākutstha tapa ugraṃ samāsthitam || 7.76.3 ||
translation: न not, मिथ्या falsely, ऽहं I, वदे speak, राम O Rama, देवलोकजिगीषया with the desire to conquer the world of gods, शूद्रं a Shudra, मां me, विद्धि know, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, तप penance, उग्रं severe, समास्थितम् engaged in.
explanation: Shambuka affirmed to Rama that he was not speaking falsely out of a desire to conquer the world of gods, and asked Rama to know him as a Shudra engaged in severe penance.

shloka_text: भाषतस्तस्य शूद्रस्य खड्गं सुरुचिरप्रभम् । निष्कृष्य कोशाद्विमलं शिरश्चिच्छेद राघवः ।। 7.76.4 ।।
transliteration: bhāṣatastasya śūdrasya khaḍgaṃ suruciraprabham | niṣkṛṣya kośādvimalaṃ śiraściccheda rāghavaḥ || 7.76.4 ||
translation: भाषतः while speaking, तस्य of that, शूद्रस्य of the Shudra, खड्गं sword, सुरुचिरप्रभम् of very beautiful luster, निष्कृष्य having drawn out, कोशात् from the sheath, विमलम् spotless, शिरः head, चिच्छेद cut off, राघवः Rama.
explanation: Rama, having drawn his spotless sword of very beautiful luster from its sheath, cut off the head of that Shudra while he was speaking.

shloka_text: तस्मिञ्छूद्रे हते देवाः सेन्द्राः साग्निपुरोगमाः । साधु साध्विति काकुत्स्थं प्रशशंसुर्मुहुर्मुहुः ।। 7.76.5 ।।
transliteration: tasmiñchūdre hate devāḥ sendrāḥ sāgnipurogamāḥ | sādhu sādhviti kākutsthaṃ praśaśaṃsurmuhurmuhuḥ || 7.76.5 ||
translation: तस्मिन् that, शूद्रे Shudra, हते having been killed, देवाः gods, सेन्द्राः with Indra, साग्निपुरोगमाः with Agni as their leader, साधु साधु इति "Excellent! Excellent!" thus, काकुत्स्थं Rama, प्रशशंसुः praised, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again.
explanation: When that Shudra was killed, the gods, led by Indra and Agni, repeatedly praised Rama, exclaiming "Excellent! Excellent!"

shloka_text: पुष्पवृष्टिर्महत्यासीद्दिव्यानां सुसुगन्धिनाम् । पुष्पाणां वायुमुक्तानां सर्वतः प्रपपात ह ।। 7.76.6 ।।
transliteration: puṣpavṛṣṭirmahatyāsīddivyānāṃ susugandhinām | puṣpāṇāṃ vāyumuktānāṃ sarvataḥ prapapāta ha || 7.76.6 ||
translation: पुष्पवृष्टिः shower of flowers, महती great, आसीत् was, दिव्यानाम् divine, सुसुगन्धिनाम् very fragrant, पुष्पाणाम् of flowers, वायुमुक्तानाम् released by the wind, सर्वतः from all sides, प्रपपात ह fell down indeed.
explanation: A great shower of divine, very fragrant flowers, released by the wind, fell down from all sides.

shloka_text: सुप्रीताश्चाब्रुवन्रामं देवाः सत्यपराक्रमम् । सुरकार्यमिदं सौम्य सुकृतं ते महामते ।। 7.76.7 ।।
transliteration: suprītāścābruvanrāmaṃ devāḥ satyaparākramam | surakāryamidaṃ saumya sukṛtaṃ te mahāmate || 7.76.7 ||
translation: सुप्रीताः very pleased, च and, अब्रुवन् said, रामं to Rama, देवाः gods, सत्यपराक्रमम् of true valor, सुरकार्यम् work of the gods, इदम् this, सौम्य O gentle one, सुकृतम् well done, ते by you, महामते O great-minded one.
explanation: The very pleased gods then said to Rama, the one of true valor, "O gentle and great-minded one, this task for the gods has been well accomplished by you."

shloka_text: गृहाण च वरं सौम्य यत्त्वमिच्छस्यरिन्दम । स्वर्गभाङ्नहि शूद्रो ऽयं त्वत्कृते रघुनन्दन ।। 7.76.8 ।।
transliteration: gṛhāṇa ca varaṃ saumya yattvamicchasyarindama | svargabhāṅnahi śūdro 'yaṃ tvatkṛte raghunandana || 7.76.8 ||
translation: गृहाण accept, च and, वरम् boon, सौम्य O gentle one, यत् which, त्वम् you, इच्छसि desire, अरिन्दम O subduer of enemies, स्वर्गभाक् partaker of heaven, न not, हि indeed, शूद्रः Shudra, अयम् this, त्वत्कृते because of you, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus.
explanation: "O gentle one, subduer of enemies, and delight of the Raghus, accept any boon you desire, for this Shudra will certainly not attain heaven because of your action."

shloka_text: देवानां भाषितं श्रुत्वा राघवः सुसमाहितः । उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं सहस्राक्षं पुरन्दरम् ।। 7.76.9 ।।
transliteration: devānāṃ bhāṣitaṃ śrutvā rāghavaḥ susamāhitaḥ | uvāca prāñjalirvākyaṃ sahasrākṣaṃ purandaram || 7.76.9 ||
translation: देवानां of the gods, भाषितं speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, राघवः Rama, सुसमाहितः very attentive, उवाच spoke, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, वाक्यं words, सहस्राक्षं to the thousand-eyed one, पुरन्दरम् to the destroyer of cities.
explanation: Having heard the words of the gods, Rama, composed and with folded hands, spoke to Indra, the thousand-eyed destroyer of cities.

shloka_text: यदि देवाः प्रसन्ना मे द्विजपुत्रः स जीवतु । दिशन्तु वरमेतं मे इप्सितं परमं मम ।। 7.76.10 ।।
transliteration: yadi devāḥ prasannā me dvijaputraḥ sa jīvatu | diśantu varametaṃ me ipsitaṃ paramaṃ mama || 7.76.10 ||
translation: यदि if, देवाः gods, प्रसन्नाः pleased, मे with me, द्विजपुत्रः the son of the brahmin, सः he, जीवतु may live, दिशन्तु may they grant, वरम् boon, एतम् this, मे to me, इप्सितं desired, परमं supreme, मम my.
explanation: Rama requested that if the gods were pleased with him, they should grant his greatest desire: that the brahmin's son be brought back to life.

shloka_text: ममापचाराद्यातो ऽसौ ब्राह्मणस्यैकपुत्रकः । अप्राप्तकालः कालेन नीतो वैवस्वतक्षयम् ।। 7.76.11 ।।
transliteration: mamāpacārādyāto 'sau brāhmaṇasyaikaputrakaḥ | aprāptakālaḥ kālena nīto vaivasvatakṣayam || 7.76.11 ||
translation: मम my, अपचारात् due to fault, यातः gone, असौ that, ब्राह्मणस्य of the brahmin, एकपुत्रकः only son, अप्राप्तकालः whose time had not come, कालेन by time, नीतः taken, वैवस्वतक्षयम् to the abode of Yama.
explanation: Rama declared that the brahmin's only son, whose time had not yet come, was taken to Yama's abode due to Rama's own transgression.

shloka_text: तं जीवयथ भद्रं वो नानृतं कर्तुमर्हथ । द्विजस्य संश्रुतो ऽर्थो मे जीवयिष्यामि ते सुतम् ।। 7.76.12 ।।
transliteration: taṃ jīvayatha bhadraṃ vo nānṛtaṃ kartumarhatha | dvijasya saṃśruto 'rtho me jīvayiṣyāmi te sutam || 7.76.12 ||
translation: तं him, जीवयथ you revive, भद्रं welfare, वः to you, न not, अनृतं untruth, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हथ you ought, द्विजस्य to the brahmin, संश्रुतः promised, अर्थः word, मे by me, जीवयिष्यामि I shall revive, ते your, सुतम् son.
explanation: Rama urged the gods to revive the child, wishing them well, and reminded them that he had promised the brahmin to bring his son back to life, thus he could not allow his word to be false.

shloka_text: राघवस्य तु तद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा विबुधसत्तमाः । प्रत्युचू राघवं प्रीता देवाः प्रीतिसमन्वितम् ।। 7.76.13 ।।
transliteration: rāghavasya tu tadvākyaṃ śrutvā vibudhasattamāḥ | pratyucū rāghavaṃ prītā devāḥ prītisamanvitam || 7.76.13 ||
translation: राघवस्य of Rama, तु indeed, तत् that, वाक्यं speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, विबुधसत्तमाः the best among the gods, प्रत्युचू replied, राघवम् to Rama, प्रीताः pleased, देवाः gods, प्रीतिसमन्वितम् filled with affection.
explanation: Having heard Rama's words, the best among the gods, pleased and filled with affection, replied to Rama.

shloka_text: निर्वृतो भव काकुत्स्थ सो ऽस्मिन्नहनि बालकः । जीवितं प्राप्तवान्भूयः समेतश्चापि बन्धुभिः ।। 7.76.14 ।।
transliteration: nirvṛto bhava kākutstha so 'sminnahani bālakaḥ | jīvitaṃ prāptavānbhūyaḥ sametaścāpi bandhubhiḥ || 7.76.14 ||
translation: निर्वृतो be relieved, भव be, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, सः that, अस्मिन् in this, अहनि day, बालकः boy, जीवितं life, प्राप्तवान् obtained, भूयः again, समेतः united, च and, अपि also, बन्धुभिः with relatives
explanation: O Kakutstha, be relieved, for that boy has regained his life and is reunited with his relatives this very day.

shloka_text: यस्मिन्मुहूर्ते काकुत्स्थ शूद्रो ऽयं विनिपातितः । तस्मिन्मुहूर्ते बालो ऽसौ जीवेन समयुज्यत ।। 7.76.15 ।।
transliteration: yasminmuhūrte kākutstha śūdro 'yaṃ vinipātitaḥ | tasminmuhūrte bālo 'sau jīvena samayujyata || 7.76.15 ||
translation: यस्मिन् in which, मुहूर्ते moment, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, शूद्रः Shudra, अयं this, विनिपातितः was killed, तस्मिन् in that, मुहूर्ते moment, बालः boy, असौ that, जीवेन with life, समयुज्यत was united
explanation: O Kakutstha, the very moment this Shudra was struck down, that boy was reunited with his life.

shloka_text: स्वस्ति प्राप्नुहि भद्रं ते साधु याम नरर्षभ । अगस्त्यस्याश्रमपदं द्रष्टुमिच्छाम राघव ।। 7.76.16 ।।
transliteration: svasti prāpnuhi bhadraṃ te sādhu yāma nararṣabha | agastyasyāśramapadaṃ draṣṭumicchāma rāghava || 7.76.16 ||
translation: स्वस्ति well-being, प्राप्नुहि obtain, भद्रं welfare, ते to you, साधु well, याम let us go, नरर्षभ O best among men, अगस्त्यस्य of Agastya, आश्रमपदं hermitage, द्रष्टुं to see, इच्छाम we wish, राघव O Raghava
explanation: May you obtain well-being, O best among men, and may good fortune be yours; we wish to go and see the hermitage of Agastya, O Raghava.

shloka_text: तस्य दीक्षा समाप्ता हि ब्रह्मर्षेः सुमहाद्युतेः । द्वादशं हि गतं वर्षं जलशय्यां समासतः ।। 7.76.17 ।।
transliteration: tasya dīkṣā samāptā hi brahmarṣeḥ sumahādyuteḥ | dvādaśaṃ hi gataṃ varṣaṃ jalaśayyāṃ samāsataḥ || 7.76.17 ||
translation: तस्य his, सुमहाद्युतेः of great splendour, ब्रह्मर्षेः of the brahmin-sage, दीक्षा the consecratory vow, समाप्ता हि is indeed completed, जलशय्यां on a bed of water, समासतः as he abode, द्वादशं वर्षम् the twelfth year, गतं हि has now passed.
explanation: The consecratory vow of that brahmin-sage of great splendour is now completed, for the twelfth year has passed as he lay abiding upon a bed of water.

shloka_text: काकुत्स्थ तद्गमिष्यामो मुनिं समभिनन्दितुम् । त्वं चाप्यागच्छ भद्रं ते द्रष्टुं तमृषिसत्तमम् ।। 7.76.18 ।।
transliteration: kākutstha tadgamiṣyāmo muniṃ samabhinanditum | tvaṃ cāpyāgaccha bhadraṃ te draṣṭuṃ tamṛṣisattamam || 7.76.18 ||
translation: काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, तत् therefore, गमिष्यामः we shall go, मुनिं the sage, समभिनन्दितुम् to greet, त्वं you, च and, अपि also, आगच्छ come, भद्रं welfare, ते to you, द्रष्टुं to see, तं that, ऋषिसत्तमम् best of sages
explanation: O Kakutstha, we shall therefore go to greet that sage, and you too should come, for your welfare, to see that best of sages.

shloka_text: स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय देवानां रघुनन्दनः । आरुरोह विमानं तं पुष्पकं हेमभूषितम् ।। 7.76.19 ।।
transliteration: sa tatheti pratijñāya devānāṃ raghunandanaḥ | āruroha vimānaṃ taṃ puṣpakaṃ hemabhūṣitam || 7.76.19 ||
translation: सः he, तथा so, इति thus, प्रतिज्ञाय having promised, देवानां of the gods, रघुनन्दनः Rama, आरुरोह ascended, विमानं aerial chariot, तं that, पुष्पकं Pushpaka, हेमभूषितम् adorned with gold
explanation: Having thus agreed to the words of the gods, Rama, the delight of the Raghus, ascended that Pushpaka aerial chariot, which was adorned with gold.

shloka_text: ततो देवाः प्रयातास्ते विमानैर्बहुविस्तरैः । रामो ऽप्यनुजगामाशु कुम्भयोनेस्तपोवनम् ।। 7.76.20 ।।
transliteration: tato devāḥ prayātāste vimānairbahuvistaraiḥ | rāmo 'pyanujagāmāśu kumbhayonestapovanam || 7.76.20 ||
translation: ततः then, देवाः the gods, प्रयाताः departed, ते they, विमानैः by aerial chariots, बहुविस्तरैः very extensive, रामः Rama, अपि also, अनुजगाम followed, आशु quickly, कुम्भयोनेः of Agastya, तपोवनम् to the hermitage.
explanation: Then, the gods departed in their vast aerial chariots, and Rama also quickly followed them to the hermitage of Agastya.

shloka_text: दृष्ट्वा तु देवान्सम्प्राप्तानगस्त्यस्तपसां निधिः । अर्चयामास धर्मात्मा सर्वांस्तानविशेषतः ।। 7.76.21 ।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tu devānsamprāptānagastyastapasāṃ nidhiḥ | arcayāmāsa dharmātmā sarvāṃstānaviśeṣataḥ || 7.76.21 ||
translation: दृष्ट्वा having seen, तु indeed, देवान् the gods, सम्प्राप्तान् who had arrived, अगस्त्यः Agastya, तपसाम् of austerities, निधिः a treasure, अर्चयामास worshipped, धर्मात्मा the righteous-souled one, सर्वान् all, तान् them, अविशेषतः without distinction.
explanation: Upon seeing the arrived gods, the righteous Agastya, a treasure-house of austerities, worshipped all of them equally without distinction.

shloka_text: प्रतिगृह्य ततः पूजां सम्पूज्य च महामुनिम् । जग्मुस्ते त्रिदशा हृष्टा नाकपृष्ठं सहानुगैः ।। 7.76.22 ।।
transliteration: pratigṛhya tataḥ pūjāṃ sampūjya ca mahāmunim | jagmuste tridaśā hṛṣṭā nākapṛṣṭhaṃ sahānugaiḥ || 7.76.22 ||
translation: प्रतिगृह्य having accepted, ततः then, पूजां the worship, सम्पूज्य and having honored, च and, महामुनिम् the great sage, जग्मुः went, ते they, त्रिदशाः the gods, हृष्टाः delighted, नाकपृष्ठम् to heaven, सहानुगैः with their followers.
explanation: Having accepted the worship and honored the great sage, the delighted gods then departed to heaven with their followers.

shloka_text: गतेषु तेषु काकुत्स्थः पुष्पकादवरुह्य च । ततो ऽभिवादयामास ह्यगस्त्यमृषिसत्तमम् ।। 7.76.23 ।।
transliteration: gateṣu teṣu kākutsthaḥ puṣpakādavaruhya ca | tato 'bhivādayāmāsa hyagastyamṛṣisattamam || 7.76.23 ||
translation: गतेषु when they had gone, तेषु those (gods), काकुत्स्थः Rama, पुष्पकात् from the Pushpaka (chariot), अवरुह्य having descended, च and, ततः then, अभिवादयामास bowed down to, हि indeed, अगस्त्यम् Agastya, ऋषिसत्तमम् the best of sages.
explanation: After the gods had departed, Rama, the descendant of Kakutstha, descended from the Pushpaka chariot and then saluted Agastya, the foremost of sages.

shloka_text: सो ऽभिवाद्य महात्मानं ज्वलन्तमिव तेजसा । आतिथ्यं परमं प्राप्य निषसाद नराधिपः ।। 7.76.24 ।।
transliteration: so 'bhivādya mahātmānaṃ jvalantamiva tejasā | ātithyaṃ paramaṃ prāpya niṣasāda narādhipaḥ || 7.76.24 ||
translation: सः he (Rama), अभिवाद्य having saluted, महात्मानम् the great-souled one (Agastya), ज्वलन्तम् shining, इव as if, तेजसा with brilliance, आतिथ्यम् hospitality, परमम् excellent, प्राप्य having received, निषसाद sat down, नराधिपः the king of men (Rama).
explanation: Having saluted the great-souled Agastya, who shone as if with brilliance, and having received excellent hospitality, the king of men, Rama, then sat down.

shloka_text: तमुवाच महातेजाः कुम्भयोनिर्महातपाः । स्वागतं ते नरश्रेष्ठ दिष्ट्या प्राप्तो ऽसि राघव ।। 7.76.25 ।।
transliteration: tamuvāca mahātejāḥ kumbhayonirmahātapāḥ | svāgataṃ te naraśreṣṭha diṣṭyā prāpto 'si rāghava || 7.76.25 ||
translation: तम् him, उवाच said, महातेजाः the greatly effulgent one, कुम्भयोनिः Agastya, महातपाः the great ascetic, स्वागतम् welcome, ते to you, नरश्रेष्ठ O best among men, दिष्ट्या fortunately, प्राप्तो ऽसि you have arrived, राघव O scion of Raghu
explanation: The greatly effulgent and great ascetic Agastya said to him, "Welcome to you, O best among men, O scion of Raghu, fortunately you have arrived."

shloka_text: त्वं मे बहुमतो राम गुणैर्बहुभिरुत्तमैः । अतिथिः पूजनीयश्च मम नित्यं हृदि स्थितः ।। 7.76.26 ।।
transliteration: tvaṃ me bahumato rāma guṇairbahubhiruttamaiḥ | atithiḥ pūjanīyaśca mama nityaṃ hṛdi sthitaḥ || 7.76.26 ||
translation: त्वम् you, मे by me, बहुमतः highly esteemed, राम O Rama, गुणैः by qualities, बहुभिः many, उत्तमैः excellent, अतिथिः a guest, पूजनीयश्च and worthy of worship, मम my, नित्यम् always, हृदि in the heart, स्थितः residing
explanation: O Rama, you are highly esteemed by me for your many excellent qualities, and you are a guest worthy of worship, always residing in my heart.

shloka_text: सुरा हि कथयन्ति त्वामागतं शूद्रघातिनम् । ब्राह्मणस्य तु धर्मेण त्वया जीवापितः सुतः ।। 7.76.27 ।।
transliteration: surā hi kathayanti tvāmāgataṃ śūdraghātinam | brāhmaṇasya tu dharmeṇa tvayā jīvāpitaḥ sutaḥ || 7.76.27 ||
translation: सुराः the gods, हि indeed, कथयन्ति speak, त्वाम् of you, आगतम् having come, शूद्रघातिनम् as the slayer of a Shudra, ब्राह्मणस्य of a Brahmin, तु but, धर्मेण by righteousness, त्वया by you, जीवापितः made alive, सुतः the son
explanation: Indeed, the gods speak of you as having come after slaying the Shudra (Shambuka), and by your righteous action, the Brahmin's son was brought back to life.

shloka_text: उष्यतां चेह रजनी सकाशे मम राघव । प्रभाते पुष्पकेण त्वं गन्ता ऽसि पुरमेव हि ।। 7.76.28 ।।
transliteration: uṣyatāṃ ceha rajanī sakāśe mama rāghava | prabhāte puṣpakeṇa tvaṃ gantā 'si purameva hi || 7.76.28 ||
translation: उष्यताम् let it be stayed, च and, इह here, रजनी the night, सकाशे near, मम my, राघव O scion of Raghu, प्रभाते in the morning, पुष्पकेण by the Pushpaka, त्वम् you, गन्ता ऽसि will go, पुरम् to the city, एव indeed, हि certainly
explanation: O scion of Raghu, please stay here for the night near me, and in the morning, you will certainly go to your city by the Pushpaka chariot.

shloka_text: त्वं हि नारायणः श्रीमांस्त्वयि सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम् । त्वं प्रभुः सर्वदेवानां पुरुषस्त्वं सनातनः ।। 7.76.29 ।।
transliteration: tvaṃ hi nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmāṃstvayi sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam | tvaṃ prabhuḥ sarvadevānāṃ puruṣastvaṃ sanātanaḥ || 7.76.29 ||
translation: त्वम् you, हि indeed, नारायणः Narayana, श्रीमान् the glorious one, त्वयि in you, सर्वम् everything, प्रतिष्ठितम् is established, त्वम् you, प्रभुः the lord, सर्वदेवानाम् of all gods, पुरुषः the being, त्वम् you, सनातनः the eternal
explanation: Indeed, you are the glorious Narayana, in whom everything is established; you are the lord of all gods, and you are the eternal being.

shloka_text: इदं चाभरणं सौम्य निर्मितं विश्वकर्मणा । दिव्यं दिव्येन वपुषा दीप्यमानं स्वतेजसा । प्रतिगृह्णीष्व काकुत्स्थ मत्प्रियं कुरु राघव ।। 7.76.30 ।।
transliteration: idaṃ cābharaṇaṃ saumya nirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā | divyaṃ divyena vapuṣā dīpyamānaṃ svatejasā | pratigṛhṇīṣva kākutstha matpriyaṃ kuru rāghava || 7.76.30 ||
translation: इदं this, च and, आभरणं ornament, सौम्य O gentle one, निर्मितं created, विश्वकर्मणा by Vishwakarma, दिव्यं divine, दिव्येन with divine, वपुषा form/body, दीप्यमानं shining, स्वतेजसा with its own splendor, प्रतिगृह्णीष्व accept, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, मत्प्रियं my pleasure, कुरु do, राघव O Raghava.
explanation: O gentle Raghava, please accept this divine ornament, created by Vishwakarma, which shines with its own splendor and divine form, and by doing so, fulfill my wish.

shloka_text: दत्तस्य हि पुनर्दाने सुमहत्फलमुच्यते । भरणे हि भवान् शक्तः सेन्द्राणां मरुतामपि ।। 7.76.31 ।।
transliteration: dattasya hi punardāne sumahatphalamucyate | bharaṇe hi bhavān śaktaḥ sendrāṇāṃ marutāmapi || 7.76.31 ||
translation: दत्तस्य of what is given, हि indeed, पुनर्दाने in giving again, सुमहत्फलम् a very great reward, उच्यते is said, भरणे in supporting, हि indeed, भवान् you, शक्तः are capable, सेन्द्राणां along with Indra, मरुतामपि even of the Maruts.
explanation: It is said that giving something again, once it has been given, yields a very great reward, and indeed, you are capable of sustaining even Indra and the Maruts.

shloka_text: त्वं हि शक्तस्तारयितुं सेन्द्रानपि दिवौकसः । तस्मात्प्रदास्ये विधिवत्तत्प्रतीच्छ नराधिप ।। 7.76.32 ।।
transliteration: tvaṃ hi śaktastārayituṃ sendrānapi divaukasaḥ | tasmātpradāsye vidhivattatpratīccha narādhipa || 7.76.32 ||
translation: त्वं you, हि indeed, शक्तः are capable, तारयितुं to save/protect, सेन्द्रानपि even Indra and others, दिवौकसः the dwellers of heaven, तस्मात् therefore, प्रदास्ये I will give, विधिवत् properly, तत् that, प्रतीच्छ accept, नराधिप O king of men.
explanation: Indeed, you are capable of protecting even the gods, including Indra, therefore I will properly give this to you; O king of men, please accept it.

shloka_text: दिव्यमाभरणं चित्रं प्रदीप्तमिव भास्करम् ।। 7.76.33 ।।
transliteration: divyamābharaṇaṃ citraṃ pradīptamiva bhāskaram || 7.76.33 ||
translation: दिव्यम् divine, आभरणं ornament, चित्रं wonderful, प्रदीप्तमिव shining like, भास्करम् the sun.
explanation: This divine and wonderful ornament shines brilliantly like the sun.

shloka_text: अथोवाच महात्मानमिक्ष्वाकूणां महारथः । रामो मतिमतां श्रेष्ठः क्षत्रधर्ममनुस्मरन् ।। 7.76.34 ।।
transliteration: athovāca mahātmānamikṣvākūṇāṃ mahārathaḥ | rāmo matimatāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ kṣatradharmamanusmaran || 7.76.34 ||
translation: अथ then, उवाच spoke, महात्मानम् to the great-souled one, इक्ष्वाकूणां of the Ikshvakus, महारथः the great warrior, रामो Rama, मतिमतां of the intelligent ones, श्रेष्ठः the best, क्षत्रधर्ममनुस्मरन् remembering the duty of a Kshatriya.
explanation: Then, Rama, the great warrior of the Ikshvakus and the best among the intelligent, spoke to the great-souled one, remembering the duties of a Kshatriya.

shloka_text: प्रतिग्रहो ऽयं भगवन्ब्राह्मणस्याविगर्हितः । गृह्णीयां क्षत्रियो ऽहं वै कथं ब्राह्मणपुङ्गव ।। 7.76.35 ।।
transliteration: pratigraho 'yaṃ bhagavanbrāhmaṇasyāvigarhitaḥ | gṛhṇīyāṃ kṣatriyo 'haṃ vai kathaṃ brāhmaṇapuṅgava || 7.76.35 ||
translation: प्रतिग्रहः acceptance of gifts, अयम् this, भगवन् O revered one, ब्राह्मणस्य for a Brahmana, अविगर्हितः blameless, गृह्णीयाम् should I accept, क्षत्रियः a Kshatriya, अहम् I, वै indeed, कथम् how, ब्राह्मणपुङ्गव O best among Brahmanas.
explanation: Rama questions the sage, asking how he, a Kshatriya, can accept a gift that is considered blameless only for a Brahmana.

shloka_text: ब्राह्मणेन विशेषेण दत्तं तद्वक्तुमर्हसि । एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण प्रत्युवाच महानृषिः ।। 7.76.36 ।।
transliteration: brāhmaṇena viśeṣeṇa dattaṃ tadvaktumarhasi | evamuktastu rāmeṇa pratyuvāca mahānṛṣiḥ || 7.76.36 ||
translation: ब्राह्मणेन by a Brahmana, विशेषेण especially, दत्तम् given, तत् that, वक्तुम् to tell, अर्हसि you ought, एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken, तु but, रामेण by Rama, प्रत्युवाच replied, महानृषिः the great sage.
explanation: Rama further requested the sage to explain the reason for accepting such a gift, especially when given by a Brahmana, to which the great sage then replied.

shloka_text: आसन्कृतयुगे राम ब्रह्मभूते पुरायुगे । अपार्थिवाः प्रजाः सर्वाः सुराणां तु शतक्रतुः ।। 7.76.37 ।।
transliteration: āsankṛtayuge rāma brahmabhūte purāyuge | apārthivāḥ prajāḥ sarvāḥ surāṇāṃ tu śatakratuḥ || 7.76.37 ||
translation: आसन् were, कृतयुगे in the Krita Yuga, राम O Rama, ब्रह्मभूते when Brahma was present, पुरायुगे in the ancient age, अपार्थिवाः without a king, प्रजाः the people, सर्वाः all, सुराणाम् of the gods, तु but, शतक्रतुः Indra.
explanation: The great sage began by telling Rama that in the ancient Krita Yuga, when the world was pure, all people were without an earthly king, though Indra was the ruler of the gods.

shloka_text: ताः प्रजा देवदेवेशं राजार्थं समुपाद्रवन् । सुराणां स्थापितो राजा त्वया देव शतक्रतुः ।। 7.76.38 ।।
transliteration: tāḥ prajā devadeveśaṃ rājārthaṃ samupādravan | surāṇāṃ sthāpito rājā tvayā deva śatakratuḥ || 7.76.38 ||
translation: ताः those, प्रजाः people, देवदेवेशम् to the Lord of gods, राजार्थम् for the sake of a king, समुपाद्रवन् approached, सुराणाम् of the gods, स्थापितः established, राजा king, त्वया by you, देव O god, शतक्रतुः Indra.
explanation: Those people approached the Lord of gods (Brahma) requesting a king, reminding him that he had already established Indra as the king of the gods.

shloka_text: प्रयच्छ नो हि लोकेश पार्थिवं नरपुङ्गवम् । यस्मै पूजां प्रयुञ्जाना धूतपापाश्चरेमहि । न वसामो विना राज्ञा एष नो निश्चयः परः ।। 7.76.39 ।।
transliteration: prayaccha no hi lokeśa pārthivaṃ narapuṅgavam | yasmai pūjāṃ prayuñjānā dhūtapāpāścaremahi | na vasāmo vinā rājñā eṣa no niścayaḥ paraḥ || 7.76.39 ||
translation: प्रयच्छ give, नः to us, हि indeed, लोकेश O Lord of the worlds, पार्थिवम् an earthly ruler, नरपुङ्गवम् a best among men, यस्मै to whom, पूजां worship, प्रयुञ्जानाः offering, धूतपापाः having cleansed sins, चरेमहि we may live, न not, वसामः we live, विना without, राज्ञा a king, एषः this, नः our, निश्चयः firm resolve, परः supreme.
explanation: The people implored Brahma, the Lord of the worlds, to grant them an earthly king, a best among men, whom they could worship to cleanse their sins and under whose rule they could live, as they declared their supreme resolve not to live without a king.

shloka_text: प्रजानां वचनं श्रुत्वा निश्चयित्वा ऽर्थमुत्तमम् ।। 7.76.40 ।।
transliteration: prajānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā niścayitvā 'rthamuttamam || 7.76.40 ||
translation: प्रजानाम् of the subjects, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, निश्चयित्वा having ascertained, अर्थम् the purpose, उत्तमम् excellent.
explanation: Having heard the words of the subjects, and having ascertained their excellent purpose.

shloka_text: ततो ब्रह्मा सुरश्रेष्ठो लोकपालान्सवासवान् । समाहूयाब्रवीत्सर्वांस्तेजोभागान्प्रयच्छत ।। 7.76.41 ।।
transliteration: tato brahmā suraśreṣṭho lokapālānsavāsavān | samāhūyābravītsarvāṃstejobhāgānprayacchata || 7.76.41 ||
translation: ततः then, ब्रह्मा Brahma, सुरश्रेष्ठः best among gods, लोकपालान् the protectors of the worlds, सवासवान् along with Vasava (Indra), समाहूय having summoned, अब्रवीत् said, सर्वान् to all, तेजोभागान् shares of your splendor, प्रयच्छत give.
explanation: Then, Brahma, the best among gods, summoned all the protectors of the worlds, including Indra, and told them to bestow shares of their splendor.

shloka_text: ततो ददुर्लोकपालाः सर्वे भागान्स्वतेजसः । अक्षुपच्च ततो ब्रह्मा यतो जातः क्षुपो नृपः ।। 7.76.42 ।।
transliteration: tato dadurlokapālāḥ sarve bhāgānsvatejasaḥ | akṣupacca tato brahmā yato jātaḥ kṣupo nṛpaḥ || 7.76.42 ||
translation: ततः then, ददुः gave, लोकपालाः the protectors of the worlds, सर्वे all, भागान् shares, स्वतेजसः of their own splendor, अक्षुपत् च and sneezed, ततः then, ब्रह्मा Brahma, यतः from which, जातः was born, क्षुपः Kṣupa, नृपः the king.
explanation: Then all the protectors of the worlds gave shares of their own splendor, and then Brahma sneezed, from which King Kṣupa was born.

shloka_text: तं ब्रह्मा लोकपालानां सहांशैः समयोजयत् । ततो ददौ नृपं तासां प्रजानामीश्वरं क्षुपम् ।। 7.76.43 ।।
transliteration: taṃ brahmā lokapālānāṃ sahāṃśaiḥ samayojayat | tato dadau nṛpaṃ tāsāṃ prajānāmīśvaraṃ kṣupam || 7.76.43 ||
translation: तम् him, ब्रह्मा Brahma, लोकपालानाम् of the protectors of the worlds, सहांशैः with their shares (of splendor), समयोजयत् endowed, ततः then, ददौ gave, नृपम् the king, तासाम् of those, प्रजानाम् subjects, ईश्वरम् the ruler, क्षुपम् Kṣupa.
explanation: Brahma then endowed him (Kṣupa) with the shares of splendor from the protectors of the worlds, and then gave King Kṣupa as the ruler of those subjects.

shloka_text: तत्रैन्द्रेण च भागेन महीमाज्ञापयन्नृपः । वारुणेन तु भागेन वपुः पुष्यति पार्थिवः ।। 7.76.44 ।।
transliteration: tatraindreṇa ca bhāgena mahīmājñāpayannṛpaḥ | vāruṇena tu bhāgena vapuḥ puṣyati pārthivaḥ || 7.76.44 ||
translation: तत्र there, ऐन्द्रेण with the share of Indra, च and, भागेन with the share, महीम् the earth, आज्ञापयन् rules, नृपः the king, वारुणेन with the share of Varuna, तु but, भागेन with the share, वपुः the body, पुष्यति nourishes, पार्थिवः the king.
explanation: There, the king rules the earth with the share of Indra, and with the share of Varuna, the king nourishes his body.

shloka_text: कौबेरेण तु भागेन वित्तमासां ददौ तदा । यस्तु याम्यो ऽभवद्भागस्तेन शास्ति स्म स प्रजाः ।। 7.76.45 ।।
transliteration: kaubereṇa tu bhāgena vittamāsāṃ dadau tadā | yastu yāmyo 'bhavadbhāgastena śāsti sma sa prajāḥ || 7.76.45 ||
translation: कौबेरेण by the northern (Kubera's), तु indeed, भागेन part, वित्तम् wealth, आसाम् to them, ददौ he gave, तदा then, यः which, तु but, याम्यः southern (Yama's), अभवत् was, भागः part, तेन by that, शास्ति स्म he ruled, सः he, प्रजाः the subjects.
explanation: Then, he gave wealth to the people from the northern part (Kubera's domain), and with the southern part (Yama's domain), he ruled his subjects.

shloka_text: तत्रैन्द्रेण नरश्रेष्ठ भागेन रघुनन्दन । प्रतिगृह्णीष्व भद्रं ते तारणार्थं मम प्रभो ।। 7.76.46 ।।
transliteration: tatraindreṇa naraśreṣṭha bhāgena raghunandana | pratigṛhṇīṣva bhadraṃ te tāraṇārthaṃ mama prabho || 7.76.46 ||
translation: तत्र there, ऐन्द्रेण by the eastern (Indra's), नरश्रेष्ठ O best among men, भागेन part, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus, प्रतिगृह्णीष्व please accept, भद्रं welfare, ते to you, तारणार्थं for the purpose of saving, मम me, प्रभो O lord.
explanation: O best among men, O delight of the Raghus, O lord, please accept this eastern part (Indra's domain) for my salvation; may good fortune be yours.

shloka_text: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ऋषेः परमधार्मिकम् । तद्रामः प्रतिजग्राह मुनेराभरणं वरम् ।। 7.76.47 ।।
transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā ṛṣeḥ paramadhārmikam | tadrāmaḥ pratijagrāha munerābharaṇaṃ varam || 7.76.47 ||
translation: तस्य his, तत् that, वचनं word, श्रुत्वा having heard, ऋषेः of the sage, परमधार्मिकम् most righteous, तत् that, रामः Rama, प्रतिजग्राह accepted, मुनेः of the sage, आभरणं ornament, वरम् excellent.
explanation: Having heard that most righteous speech of the sage, Rama accepted that excellent ornament from the sage.

shloka_text: प्रतिगृह्य ततो रामस्तदाभरणमुत्तमम् । आगमं तस्य दीप्तस्य प्रष्टुमेवोपचक्रमे ।। 7.76.48 ।।
transliteration: pratigṛhya tato rāmastadābharaṇamuttamam | āgamaṃ tasya dīptasya praṣṭumevopacakrame || 7.76.48 ||
translation: प्रतिगृह्य having accepted, ततः then, रामः Rama, तत् that, आभरणम् ornament, उत्तमम् excellent, आगमं origin, तस्य of that, दीप्तस्य shining, प्रष्टुम् to ask, एव indeed, उपचक्रमे began.
explanation: Having accepted that excellent ornament, Rama then began to inquire about the origin of that radiant object.

shloka_text: अत्यद्भुतमिदं दिव्यं वपुषा युक्तमुत्तमम् । कथं वा भगवता प्राप्तं कुतो वा केन वा हृतम् ।। 7.76.49 ।।
transliteration: atyadbhutamidaṃ divyaṃ vapuṣā yuktamuttamam | kathaṃ vā bhagavatā prāptaṃ kuto vā kena vā hṛtam || 7.76.49 ||
translation: अति extremely, अद्भुतम् wonderful, इदं this, दिव्यं divine, वपुषा with a form, युक्तम् endowed, उत्तमम् excellent, कथं how, वा or, भगवता by your revered self, प्राप्तं obtained, कुतः from where, वा or, केन by whom, वा or, हृतम् taken away.
explanation: Rama asked, "How was this extremely wonderful, divine, and excellent form obtained by your revered self, or from where, or by whom was it taken away?"

shloka_text: कुतूहलितया ब्रह्मन्पृच्छामि त्वां महायशः । आश्चर्याणां बहूनां हि निधिः परमको भवान् ।। 7.76.50 ।।
transliteration: kutūhalitayā brahmanpṛcchāmi tvāṃ mahāyaśaḥ | āścaryāṇāṃ bahūnāṃ hi nidhiḥ paramako bhavān || 7.76.50 ||
translation: कुतूहलितया out of curiosity, ब्रह्मन् O Brahmana, पृच्छामि I ask, त्वां you, महायशः O greatly renowned one, आश्चर्याणां of wonders, बहूनां many, हि indeed, निधिः a treasure, परमको supreme, भवान् you are
explanation: O greatly renowned Brahmana, I ask you out of curiosity, for you are indeed a supreme treasure of many wonders.

shloka_text: एवं ब्रुवति काकुत्स्थे मुनिर्वाक्यमथाब्रवीत् । शृणु राम यथावृत्तं पुरा त्रेतायुगे युगे ।। 7.76.51 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ bruvati kākutsthe munirvākyamathābravīt | śṛṇu rāma yathāvṛttaṃ purā tretāyuge yuge || 7.76.51 ||
translation: एवं thus, ब्रुवति when speaking, काकुत्स्थे Kakutstha (Rama), मुनिः the sage, वाक्यम् words, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, शृणु listen, राम O Rama, यथावृत्तं as it happened, पुरा formerly, त्रेतायुगे in the Treta Yuga, युगे in the age
explanation: When Rama, the descendant of Kakutstha, spoke thus, the sage then replied, "Listen, O Rama, to what happened formerly in the Treta Yuga."

shloka_text: रमणीयप्रदेशे ऽस्मिन् वने यद्दृष्टवानहम् । आश्चर्यं मे महाबाहो दानमाश्रित्य केवलम् ।। 7.76.52 ।।
transliteration: ramaṇīyapradeśe 'smin vane yaddṛṣṭavānaham | āścaryaṃ me mahābāho dānamāśritya kevalam || 7.76.52 ||
translation: रमणीयप्रदेशे in this beautiful region, अस्मिन् in this, वने forest, यत् which, दृष्टवान् saw, अहम् I, आश्चर्यं a wonder, मे to me, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, दानम् charity, आश्रित्य concerning, केवलम् merely
explanation: O mighty-armed one, I saw a wonder in this beautiful forest region, which was solely concerning the power of charity. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे षट्सप्ततितमः सर्गः ।। 76 ।। Thus ends the seventy-sixth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
